records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

It looks like setup stalled before the first project. If it would help, I can set up your first project with you so there's less to figure out on your own.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Systems
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Glad to have Quartz Systems on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Systems* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, nothing started despite two outreach emails (email:00fc5811, email:7af3531b). Ana replied only vaguely -- "busy week but planning to dig in properly soon" (email:69930d0d) -- showing intent but no action. Open bulk-import ticket (tick_b3dd3469225e) still unresolved (email:f29264c3), a plausible blocker. Pro plan signals real intent.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the note -- totally understand it's been a busy week, and no rush on your end.

On your open ticket about importing from a spreadsheet: Tariq is still looking into the contacts side, and I'll make sure it stays on his radar. One thing I can confirm today is that teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

When you're ready to dig in, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them. Would a short call this week help to get your first real project set up together?

Best,
Priya
